verdicts.question: What type of roof is present at the site?
verdicts.designer_notes: Puff sheet and plane sheet roof

verdicts.rationale: Proposed PV areas are clearly corrugated metal sheeting.

verdicts.question: Are there any obstructions on the roof that could affect the solar installation?
verdicts.photo_observation: Turbo ventilator (whirlybird) on the sheet roof near the PV zone (p13, p22); skylight/ridge strips on roof; no tall shading objects near proposed arrays.
verdicts.rationale: A roof ventilator sits right beside the planned module area; it may or may not affect layout. Reviewer should confirm.

verdicts.question: What is the angle of the panels? (in degrees)

verdicts.rationale: Notes consistent with drawing and low visual slope, but main answer is blank and exact angle cannot be verified visually.

verdicts.question: On how many roofs at the site are we installing solar?
verdicts.photo_observation: Page 5 shows two layouts (Roof 1: 184 modules, Roof 2: 59 modules); p9/p10 captions refer to crane routes for roof 1 and roof 2.
verdicts.rationale: Two roofs documented consistently.

verdicts.question: What type of mounting structure is planned?
verdicts.photo_observation: Corrugated metal sheet roofs with standing seams/ribs (p11-16), the typical case for mini-rail clamp mounting; no RCC/ballast context at PV zones.
verdicts.rationale: Mini-rails are appropriate for sheet roofs; no contradiction.

verdicts.question: What is the orientation of the solar panels?
verdicts.photo_observation: p16 shows PV overlays on slopes captioned 'South slope' and 'North slope'; p5 layouts show slope arrows along the short axis.
verdicts.rationale: Photo captions agree with designer's South and North orientations; compass not independently verified.

verdicts.question: How can the roof be accessed?
verdicts.photo_observation: A fixed yellow steel staircase leads up to the lower RCC terrace (p7, p10); a worker carries an aluminium ladder at the sheet-roof edge (p8). Observations page says roof access via ladder.
verdicts.rationale: Staircase exists to terrace, ladder used for sheet roof; answer is plausible but a reviewer should confirm which applies.

verdicts.rationale: Operational finished industrial building.
